chambers_communications.summary: Email JA, subject case number/name/matter, copy parties unless legally authorized exception; no direct merits communications to judge.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email identifiable attachments, no file-sharing links; motions PDF, orders Word. Guide special-set materials passage says3business days, later evidentiary-copy deadline says3days; both retained.

emergency_routing.summary: File detailed motion and email JA with Request for Emergency Hearing in subject; court determines whether to schedule expedited hearing.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first. Online coordinated hearings1hour or less; longer hearings email JA with filed motion, requested duration/reason and opposing position. No piggyback motions without JA permission. File/serve notice immediately after reservation; notice states appearance mode, Zoom credentials when remote and ADA notice. Email motion/notice and UMC Word order within5days of scheduling. Cancel online and file cancellation plus email JA by noon preceding day.

noncommercial_substantive_procedures.summary: Juvenile, mental-health, post-conviction, guardianship/probate merits and detailed trial/form requirements outside general commercial focus. Basic shared operating requirements only.

probate_routing.summary: Memo p1 sends all probate(CP) checklists/petitions/motions/orders/letters to ProbateIRC@circuit19.org; guardianship excluded from that channel. Follow up in original thread with case managers, not by calling JA or duplicate email. Mark urgent submissions. No hard-copy or portal proposed orders/letters; email case managers.

proposed_orders.summary: Word orders emailed to JA except probate channel. Cover letter affirmatively identifies agreement/disagreement and service addresses; silence is not stated consent. If asked to prepare posthearing order, circulate within2business days and submit within7days unless otherwise ordered.

remote_appearances.summary: Hybrid under Rule2.530; Zoom3062714322, no password. Evidentiary hearings over30minutes in person unless prior permission; non-evidentiary may be noticed virtual/in person. Remote testimony video unless accompanied by notary; notice states appearance mode.
